title: Applications under team provisioning
description: Declares the Teams, classification paths and Boards this automation manages. Paths are relative to the team project and use '/' as the separator; the project segment comes from the environment, so the same declaration works in any organization. Membership is never declared here - only the NAME of the environment variable that carries it.

key.description: Identifier passed as -ApplicationKey. No spaces, so it is safe on a command line and in a resource name.

membersEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding a separated list of sign-in addresses. The list itself is personal data and must never be committed.

name.description: Board to reconcile. Its columns come from the shared board-columns configuration.

workItemTypes.description: Types the automation verifies exist in the project process before touching the Board. A column mapped to a state that does not exist fails the whole column write with an opaque error.

default.description: Path assigned as the Team default. Relative to the project, '/' separated.

additional.description: Further paths the Team may use. Missing ones are created; existing ones are never removed.
